raw_turns.text: I'm so excited to learn about Japanese culture and get a chance to expand.

raw_turns.speaker: Dave

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a living room with a couch, table, and television] I'm heading there next month. I'll be staying in such a nice place while I'm there.

raw_turns.text: Awesome! Having a place to stay is key. What are your plans for the trip?

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
raw_turns.text: I'm planning to explore the city, try out different local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with musicians in the area.

raw_turns.text: Sounds great! Collaborating with local musicians would be an amazing experience. How long are you planning to stay in Japan?

raw_turns.speaker: Dave
raw_turns.text: Cool! Enjoy your trip! Let me know if you need any more recommendations. Have fun!

raw_turns.text: Thanks, Dave! If I need any help, I'll be sure to let you know. Stay safe!

raw_turns.speaker: Dave
raw_turns.text: Calvin, that car looks awesome! You must feel amazing every time you get inside! You deserved it - congrats buddy!

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
raw_turns.text: Wow, sounds like a blast! Which one was your favorite?

raw_turns.text: Cool, Dave! Seeing your favorite singers live must have been wild! Did you get a chance to hang out with them after the show?

raw_turns.text: Nah, didn't get to hang with them after the show, but seeing them live was cool enough. It's always a dream to see your favorites performing!

raw_turns.text: Yeah, it's always a dream to see your favorites doing their thing! So glad you got to experience that.

raw_turns.speaker: Dave
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Calvin! Yeah, it was an incredible experience. So, anything new happening in your life?

raw_turns.text: Got a new ride and wrote some new tunes - had a few studio sessions last week and I'm excited to collaborate. Can't wait to share it with everyone!

raw_turns.speaker: Dave
raw_turns.text: Cool, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing your new tunes. Keep me updated on how your collaborations go!

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
raw_turns.text: Yeah, no worries! I'll definitely let you know how it goes. Cheers!

raw_turns.speaker: Dave
raw_turns.text: Enjoy the collaborations, Calvin! Stay safe!

raw_turns.text: Thanks, Dave! Gonna have fun and stay safe with it. Bye!

raw_turns.text: Hey Dave! Long time no see. I just went to an awesome music thingy in Tokyo - so cool!

raw_turns.text: Hey Calvin! Great to hear from you. How was the music thingy in Tokyo? See any cool bands?

raw_turns.speaker: Dave
raw_turns.text: Wow, Calvin, sounds great! What did you learn from it?

raw_turns.text: I learned a lot and got some great advice from professionals in the music industry. It was inspiring!

raw_turns.text: Wow, Calvin! Bet that was inspiring being surrounded by professionals. Did you get any advice from them?

raw_turns.text: Wow, Calvin! It's really motivating to see you staying true to yourself. It got me thinking, where do you see your music taking you?

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show] Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston!

raw_turns.text: Thanks! It definitely took a lot of work. Have you had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs?

raw_turns.text: Not yet, been pretty busy with rehearsals and traveling. But I'm looking forward to exploring the city, trying out some delicious food, and visiting the popular attractions. Maybe we can grab a bite together when I'm there?

raw_turns.text: Definitely, Cal! Let's grab some food and I'll show you my favorite spots in the city. Can't wait to show them to you!

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
raw_turns.text: Sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to try out the food there with you. It'll be fun!

raw_turns.text: It'll be great, Cal! Can't wait to show you the amazing music and food here. See you soon!

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage] Wow Dave! Congrats on opening your own car maintenance shop! It looks like all your hard work and dedication paid off.

raw_turns.text: Thanks, Cal! It's great to see my hard work paying off. Opening this shop was my dream, and I'm really happy to see it getting started. It was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it.

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a book with a space theme on it] Woo, Dave! Congrats on achieving your dream - you've got guts and ambition - that's awesome! Keep it up!

raw_turns.text: Thanks! Appreciate the support. My dream was to open a shop and it's a step towards my other dream of working on classic cars. I love their design and engineering.

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot] Wow, Dave! Going for it with classic cars is cool! Fulfilling your dreams is so important.

raw_turns.text: Wow, Dave! That looks awesome!

raw_turns.text: Yeah! It feels great to see the hard work pay off, it's like bringing something back to life.

raw_turns.text: Yeah, Calvin! It's such an amazing feeling to see something you create become a reality. Knowing that your skills and hard work made it happen is incredible.

raw_turns.speaker: Calvin
